title: Card
description: The universal container: a hairline box with a header, a body and a footer that agree with each other.
usage: The default box for grouped content. If a thing has a title, a body and actions, it is a card; if it only has a body, use a plain section.
a11y: A card is a region, not a landmark: give the page real headings and let the card carry an aria-label only when it needs a name.
